register.labelZh: STAY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: STAY 片語動詞可以表示人們保持安全距離,或物件留在正確位置,例如 stay back、stay away、stay in、stay on、stay down 和 stay up。；stay around、stay behind、stay out 和 stay over 可以用來說明某人留在哪裏,以及逗留多久。；stay off 可以表示避免喝酒,或因病而不上班;stay out of 則可以表示選擇不介入某個問題。；stay ahead 表示保持優勢,而 stay with something 則表示即使遇到困難也繼續下去。
register.summaryEn: STAY expressions can show that people keep a safe distance or that objects remain in the correct place: stay back, stay away, stay in, stay on, stay down and stay up. Stay around, stay behind, stay out and stay over help you explain where someone remains and how long they remain there. You can use stay off to describe avoiding alcohol or missing work because of illness. Stay out of can describe choosing not to become involved in a problem. Stay ahead describes keeping an advantage, while stay with something describes continuing even when it is difficult.
contextsZh: 表達明智的選擇和限制
